definitions.primary: Sum of queue waits across each completed outpatient journey; no-show absence and service excluded
definitions.p90: Mean of replication-specific P90s, not pooled P90
definitions.horizon: Finite observation day; unfinished and not-yet-arrived patients reported separately
definitions.room_speeds: Synthetic resource heterogeneity, not patient-priority weights
definitions.outages: Non-preemptive; started work completes and may overrun scheduled availability

limitations: Completed-only means can have selection bias; inspect unserved counts
All urgency labels are synthetic inputs; no autonomous clinical decision
Staffed-room experiment extends rather than replaces the existing FCFS/urgency/hybrid baseline
Population service means guide room choice; individual predicted duration never changes patient order
